tradeablePreFilter: confidence in {HIGH, MEDIUM, MANUAL} (LOW-confidence items go to the watchlist)
deal not completed (includes cross-filing completion notices)
target price resolvable via Yahoo Finance with a priceAsOf timestamp
consideration terms extracted: cash -> offerPricePerShare; stock/collar -> exchangeRatio + acquirer price; mixed -> cash leg at minimum (stock leg added when exchangeRatio + acquirer price resolve)

spreadFormulas.stockOrCollar: impliedValue = exchangeRatio * acquirerPrice; spreadPct = impliedValue / targetPrice - 1
spreadFormulas.mixed: impliedValue = offerPricePerShare + exchangeRatio * acquirerPrice when both legs resolve, else cash leg only (flagged in tradeableNote)

verdictLadder: NOT TRADEABLE — pre-filter failed (reason in tradeableReason)
NO EDGE — merger of equals — no directional spread for this engine
NO TIMELINE — cannot annualize — spread computed but no expectedCloseDate
STUB — sailed — spreadPct < 1% with <=10 trading days to close (excluded from TRADEABLE counts/cards)
verdictCriteria.stubRationale: A stub annualizes impressively (e.g. 14.8% on 5 days) but the absolute spread — cents per share — cannot compensate binary deal-break downside (targets typically fall 20-40% on a break) or retail frictions (bid/ask, settlement). Flagging stubs as sailed keeps the board from presenting a closed-out opportunity as TRADEABLE.
verdictCriteria.thinThresholdRationale: Annualized gross spread must clear 8% to compensate for binary deal-break downside (targets typically fall 20-40% on a break), opportunity cost vs ~4% T-bills, and unmodeled frictions (borrow cost on stock legs, taxes). Sub-8% spreads are the historical norm for announced deals; the board marks them THIN honestly rather than lowering the bar to manufacture TRADEABLEs.
verdictCriteria.capacityMath: Expected gross at $10k / $25k / $50k notionals, $0 commissions, gross of borrow costs and taxes. annualizedGross = notional * annualizedSpreadPct.
knownDataGaps: Borrow cost/availability for stock-deal short legs is not modeled (borrowData: unavailable).
SEC 8-K coverage is PARTIAL: S&P 500 universe, ~120-day lookback; expected-close guidance often lives in press-release exhibits the miner only fetches when 8-K body terms are missing.
Timeline gaps are filled via manual deals (data/arb-deals.manual.json) with the source language quoted in each deal thesis.
verdictCriteria.displayRule: The homepage renderer counts and cards only deals whose verdict starts with "TRADEABLE". The `tradeable` boolean is a pre-filter, not the display count.

deals.thesis: Paramount Skydance acquiring Warner Bros. Discovery (Feb 27, 2026 merger agreement, ~$110B). Consideration is $31.00 cash plus a $0.00277778/share/day ticking fee for each day after Sept 30 through closing; the companies' Sept 30, 2026 PR announced an anticipated close of Oct 6, 2026 (subject to customary closing conditions; state-AG settlement approved, removing the final legal hurdle). Offer price set to the Oct-6 ticking-fee value $31.01666668 — this understates consideration if close slips (conservative). Timeline and ticking-fee terms added manually. Very short fuse: re-check before any use.

deals.thesis: Thoma Bravo acquiring Accelerant Holdings at $20.25/share cash (announced Aug 13, 2026). Company guides close in H1 2027 — using Jun 30 per timeline conventions. De-riskers: Altamont Capital (82% voting) committed; no financing condition; 6% annualized ticking fee if regulatory delays push close (delay compensates). Risks: state insurance-commissioner approvals are the real overhang (insurance deals always carry this tail); outside-date extensions possible. Source: 2026-10-01 research hunt.

deals.confidenceReason: user-entered manual deal
deals.thesis: Fox acquiring Roku: $96 cash PLUS 0.9693 FOX Class A shares per Roku share (June 14, 2026 agreement, ~$22-23B). CORRECTED vs the mined entry: the miner resolved the acquirer to FOX (Class B, ~$56); the merger agreement specifies Class A shares, so implied value and spread are recomputed on FOXA (~$62.65) — the mined 'NEGATIVE' verdict was an artifact of the wrong share class. Companies still guide close in H1 calendar 2027 despite the DOJ second request (Sept 8, 2026); S-4 effective Sept 1, 2026. Stock leg requires shorting FOXA; borrow data unavailable. Timeline added manually.

deals.thesis: Intercontinental Exchange acquiring MarketAxess at $167/share cash (8-K filed July 30, 2026, ~$6.0B equity value). The 8-K body carries no close-date guidance; ICE's debt-offering prospectus and press materials state the transaction 'is expected to close in the first half of 2027' — timeline added manually. Shareholder vote scheduled Oct 29, 2026; HSR waiting period refiled Sept 29, 2026. Gross spread ~1.9%.

deals.thesis: Merck KGaA acquiring Bio-Techne at $73/share cash (announced June 2026, ~$11.3B enterprise value). Company guidance is 'expected to close by late 2026 or early 2027' (Merck press release; repeated in Bio-Techne's FY2026 10-K) — no quarter-level date exists, so using end of Q1 2027 as the conservative endpoint per the timeline conventions (a later date understates the annualized spread). Timeline added manually. Gross spread ~0.7%.

deals.thesis: Madison Dearborn Partners acquiring Marygold Companies at $2.00/share cash (announced Sept 25, 2026). Company guides close in H1 2027 — using Jun 30 per timeline conventions (conservative: later date understates annualized spread). De-riskers: holders of ~75% of voting power delivered written consent (shareholder vote effectively done), unanimous board. Risks: fund-management change-of-control / regulatory consents; 5-cent absolute spread demands limit-order discipline (slippage eats it); small-cap liquidity. Source: 2026-10-01 research hunt.
